audience: warehouses and e-commerce teams that pick and ship orders in Picqer

useCases.title: Check the picking work for today
useCases.text: List the picklists per warehouse, with their status, assigned user and products. List the warehouses to get their ids.

useCases.title: Check stock of a product per warehouse
useCases.text: Find a product by name, code or barcode. Then read its stock per warehouse, with the reserved amount and the stock not reserved.

useCases.title: Review orders and their products
useCases.text: List orders filtered by status, customer, warehouse, tag or date. Open one order to read its products and addresses.

useCases.title: Review open purchase orders
useCases.text: List purchase orders with their status, supplier and warehouse. List the suppliers with their ordering details.

useCases.title: Pause or resume an order
useCases.text: Pause an order that is processing, with a reason such as a wrong address. Its open picklists pause too. Resume the order to restart them.
